name: Free Ice Lance VFX for Godot 4

nodes.doc: Global settings and one-line helpers for GLACILUX.

static_vars.name: quality
static_vars.doc: Default quality for every effect whose own quality is set to DEFAULT.

static_vars.name: wind
static_vars.doc: Wind shared by every effect with use_global_wind on, metres per second.

methods.name: check_version
methods.doc: True when the engine is new enough for the pack.

methods.name: quality_factor
methods.doc: Element count multiplier for a quality level.

methods.name: spawn
methods.signature: spawn(parent: Node, preset: Variant, position: Variant = null) -> Node
methods.doc: Instances a preset (name like "impact_shards", or a full res:// path, or a PackedScene), adds it to `parent` at `position` and starts it: a projectile sets off along its own forward axis (-Z) and an impact plays.

methods.name: preset_names
methods.doc: Every preset the pack ships, by bare name.

methods.name: warmup
methods.doc: Builds every preset (or just `presets`, bare names like "impact_shards") once under a throwaway node, keeps them for WARMUP_FRAMES frames and frees them again, so every shader is compiled and every mesh is built before the first real effect appears.

signals.name: finished
signals.doc: Emitted when a one-shot has finished, or when stop() has fully faded a looping effect.

properties.name: amount
properties.doc: Strength of the effect, 0 = off, 1 = full.

properties.name: time_scale
properties.doc: Playback speed.

properties.name: autoplay
properties.doc: Start when the node enters the tree at runtime.

properties.name: fade_time
properties.doc: Seconds play() and stop() take to fade in and out (looping effects).

properties.name: preview_in_editor
properties.doc: Animate inside the editor viewport.

properties.name: preview_interval
properties.doc: Seconds between repeats of a one-shot in the editor preview.

properties.name: random_seed
properties.doc: Random seed.

properties.name: quality
properties.doc: Element counts.

properties.name: use_global_wind
properties.doc: Add Glacilux.wind.

properties.name: wind
properties.doc: Extra wind for this node, metres per second.

properties.name: light_enabled
properties.doc: Adds an OmniLight3D that follows the effect.

properties.name: light_energy
properties.doc: Light brightness at full strength.

properties.name: light_range
properties.doc: Light reach in metres before node scale.

properties.name: light_shadows
properties.doc: Cast shadows from the light (costly; off by default).

methods.name: play
methods.doc: Starts a looping effect (fades in over fade_time).

methods.name: stop
methods.doc: Stops a looping effect (fades out over fade_time, then emits finished).

methods.name: trigger
methods.doc: Restarts a one-shot effect from the beginning.

methods.name: set_amount_smooth
methods.doc: Changes amount smoothly over `seconds`.

methods.name: effective_amount
methods.doc: amount multiplied by the play/stop fade.

methods.name: get_wind
methods.doc: Wind acting on this effect, in world units per second.

methods.name: get_age
methods.doc: Seconds since the last trigger(), or -1 when a one-shot is idle.

methods.name: get_time
methods.doc: Effect time in seconds.

methods.name: count_for
methods.doc: Element count for a layer, scaled by quality.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.doc: Rebuilds every layer (call after changing counts or shapes from code).

methods.name: is_one_shot
methods.doc: True for effects that play once (impacts, bursts).

methods.name: get_duration
methods.doc: Length of a one-shot in seconds (scaled time).

methods.name: make_layer
methods.signature: make_layer(shader: Shader, mesh: Mesh, priority: int = 0) -> ShaderMaterial
methods.doc: Creates an internal, top-level layer driven by `shader`.

methods.name: get_layer_node
methods.doc: The MeshInstance3D a layer draws into.

methods.name: set_all
methods.doc: Sets one shader parameter on every layer.

methods.name: set_light_level
methods.signature: set_light_level(level: float, color: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)) -> void
methods.doc: Light intensity 0..1 for this frame; the light is hidden at 0.

methods.name: ground_below
methods.signature: ground_below(from: Vector3, reach: float, fallback: float) -> float
methods.doc: World y of the floor below `from`, from one raycast of `reach` metres straight down.

methods.name: apply_colors
methods.doc: Sets the ice blue colours on one layer material.

nodes.doc: An ice lance in flight, with a trail of cold puffs and sparkles behind it.

signals.name: hit
signals.args: position: Vector3, normal: Vector3, collider: Object
signals.doc: Emitted when the projectile reaches something: the point, the surface normal and the collider (null when it stopped at a target point or ran out of range).

properties.name: speed
properties.doc: Launch speed in metres per second.

properties.name: gravity
properties.doc: Fall in metres per second squared.

properties.name: max_distance
properties.doc: Metres the projectile may travel before it gives up and finishes.

properties.name: max_lifetime
properties.doc: Seconds it may stay in the air.

properties.name: body_length
properties.doc: Length of the body in metres.

properties.name: body_radius
properties.doc: Half width of the body in metres.

properties.name: sides
properties.doc: Sides of the crystal.

properties.name: spin
properties.doc: Turns per second around the direction of travel.

properties.name: trail
properties.doc: Puffs of cold air left in the air behind the projectile.

properties.name: trail_span
properties.doc: Seconds of flight the trail covers.

properties.name: trail_size
properties.doc: Size of one puff in metres.

properties.name: use_raycast
properties.doc: Follow the path with a raycast and stop at the first body.

properties.name: stop_at_target
properties.doc: Stop at the point fire_at() was aimed at, even when there is nothing there to hit.

properties.name: impact_scene
properties.doc: Impact effect to play where it lands.

properties.name: impact_preset
properties.doc: Name of a preset in addons/glacilux_fx/presets/3d to play where it lands, for example "impact_shards".

properties.name: preview_flight
properties.doc: Seconds of flight the editor preview shows before it starts over.

methods.name: fire
methods.doc: Launches the projectile.

methods.name: fire_at
methods.doc: Launches the projectile so that it passes through `target_point`, arcing over it when gravity is on.

methods.name: is_flying
methods.doc: True while the projectile is in the air.

methods.name: get_flight_age
methods.doc: Seconds since fire(), or -1 when it has not been fired.

methods.name: get_flight_position
methods.doc: Where the projectile is right now, in world space.

methods.name: cancel
methods.doc: Stops the flight without a hit and lets the trail fade out.

nodes.doc: The one-shot hit of something cold: a crown of ice, flying shards, a puff of cold mist and a patch of frost left where it landed.

properties.name: radius
properties.doc: Size of the whole impact in metres: the crown, the shards and the frost patch follow it.

properties.name: spread_time
properties.doc: Seconds the frost takes to fill in.

properties.name: hold_time
properties.doc: Seconds the frost stays before it fades.

properties.name: shard_size
properties.doc: Size of one shard in metres.

properties.name: ground_from_raycast
properties.doc: Find the floor the shards bounce on with one raycast down.

properties.name: crown
properties.doc: Pointed crystals that burst up out of the hit.

properties.name: crown_size
properties.doc: Height of one crown crystal in metres.

properties.name: frost
properties.doc: Leave a patch of frost where it hit.

methods.name: burst
methods.doc: Plays the impact where the node already is.

methods.name: burst_at
methods.signature: burst_at(position: Vector3, normal: Vector3 = Vector3.UP) -> void
methods.doc: Moves the node to `position`, turns its up axis to `normal` and plays the impact, so the frost lies on the surface that was hit.

methods.name: get_burst_age
methods.doc: Seconds since the impact started, or -1 while nothing is playing.

caveats: Shards, icicles and wall debris bounce on one ground height only; they do not collide with each other or with other objects.
